title: Law to study language access and location gaps in gifted programs
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office of Child Care and Early Childhood Education, working with the Department of Education and community groups, to study how language barriers and where families live affect preschool-age children's access to early elementary gifted and talented programs. The study must look at translation and outreach supports and identify gaps in eligibility, nomination and enrollment by language group and neighborhood. A public report with findings and recommendations would be due within six months of the law taking effect.
